title: nVent Breaks Ground on Kansas Manufacturing Expansion to Support Growing Demand for Engineered Building Solutions
body_markdown:
NEWS ARTICLE


nVent Breaks Ground on Kansas Manufacturing Expansion to Support Growing Demand for Engineered Building Solutions


*58,000-square-foot expansion will increase production capacity, create skilled manufacturing jobs, and strengthen support for critical electrification infrastructure.*


nVent recently celebrated the groundbreaking of a significant expansion at its Pittsburg, Kansas manufacturing facility, reinforcing the company's continued investment in growth, innovation, and the accelerating global demand for electrification infrastructure.


More than 100 employees, customers, community leaders, trade partners, and local stakeholders gathered on August 21 to mark the start of construction on a 58,000-square-foot expansion of the site, which manufactures nVent's Engineered Building Solutions. The investment will increase manufacturing capacity, create new skilled jobs, and enhance nVent's ability to deliver critical infrastructure solutions for customers across the power, utilities, industrial, energy, and data center markets.


"As electrification continues to transform industries around the world, our customers need scalable, reliable infrastructure solutions delivered with speed and quality," said Tom Atkinson, who leads nVent's Engineered Building Solutions business. "This expansion reflects nVent's continued investment in our people, our manufacturing capabilities, and our ability to help customers connect and protect critical systems that power modern life."


## **Expanding Capacity for Growing Infrastructure Demand**


The Pittsburg expansion is designed to support increased production of nVent's Engineered Building Solutions, including prefabricated electrical houses, or e- houses, that serve as critical power-distribution and control centers. These engineered structures are used in applications ranging from utility substations and renewable energy installations to industrial facilities, data centers, transportation systems, and other mission-critical infrastructure projects. Factory-built and tested before arriving on site, e-houses help customers accelerate project schedules, reduce construction complexity, improve safety, and increase reliability. As industries invest in grid modernization, renewable energy, digitalization, and electrification, demand for these integrated solutions continues to grow.


The facility expansion will add 58,000 square feet of manufacturing and production space, enabling greater throughput through advanced manufacturing processes and enhanced product distribution capabilities. The project includes installation of a heavy-duty engineered gantry crane with a 70-ton lifting capacity, allowing teams to safely maneuver and position large electrical buildings throughout the manufacturing process. An expanded concrete production area will support approximately 36 additional e-house modules in production simultaneously, significantly increasing the site's ability to meet customer demand while maintaining safety and quality standards.


## **Investing in Manufacturing and Skilled Careers**


In addition to expanding production capacity, the project is expected to create up to 60 new skilled trade positions over the next year, strengthening the local workforce and supporting economic growth across Southeast Kansas.


"This expansion will allow us to create up to sixty new full-time jobs in the skilled trades," said Mitch Wear, Plant Senior Manager. "These are opportunities for people to build long-term careers while contributing to projects that help power communities, industries, and infrastructure around the world." The Pittsburg facility also continues to invest in workforce development through partnerships and training programs, including its electrical apprenticeship program and ongoing engagement with students and faculty from Pittsburg State University's Electrical Technology program.


## **Building for the Future of Electrification**


The groundbreaking ceremony recognized the employees whose dedication to safety, operational excellence, talent development, and community engagement has helped drive the facility's success. The expansion underscores nVent's broader strategy to invest in growth opportunities aligned with long-term electrification trends. By increasing manufacturing capacity in Pittsburg, nVent will be better positioned to support customers as they modernize infrastructure, expand energy networks, deploy data centers, integrate renewable energy, and build a more sustainable and electrified future.[Learn more about Engineered Buildings here](https://www.nvent.com/en-us/what-is-an-engineered-building) .
